buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Warranty: Three years comprehensive warranty from the date of successful installation, commissioning and acceptance by the user at DLJ 2. Onsite support during warranty: Industry Partner must depute four trained engineer and 06 skilled man power in electronics, Mechanical and Electrical stream at DLJ for operation of system for three years 3. The bidder is required to submit PCIP with EMD for Rs 2 Crore valid upto 45 days beyond final bid validit y period in favour of Director, Defence Laboratory Jodhpur in form of FDR or BG issued by scheduled nation alized bank or International bank of repute 4. The bidder should also give the offer of comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) for period of five years post warranty with scope of work as uploaded in the bid document. Th e financial evaluation criteria will be adopted considering the life cycle cost of the system and L-1 will be determined considering system cost as well as cost of CAMC. Further, the contract f or CAMC will be placed separately in offline Mode after completion of warranty as per the scop e of work as mentioned in RFP, if required. 5. Payment Terms:- (i) 30% payment of total SO value will be made to the firm after successful completion of PDR against sub mission of BG equivalent to 110% of payment amount covering delivery period + warranty (ii) 30% payment of total SO value will be made to the firm after receipt/ delivery of item at Defence Labor

atory Jodhpur based on the report of FAT (iii) Remaining 40% payment will be made to the firm after inspection, installation, ATP and training of com plete system at Defence Laboratory Jodhpur 6. The bidder is required to submit the cost break up in the financial document as asked in the bid document. This document is to be uploaded in the price bid/ financial bid only. Disclosure o f prices in technical bid will lead to rejection of offer. The break up cost will be as under:- (i) Cost of Dynamic Mobile Chaff Material Characterization Facility (ii) AMC Cost for 1st year after warranty (iii) AMC cost for 2nd year after warranty (iv) AMC cost for 3rd year after warranty (v) AMC cost for 4th year after warranty (vi) AMC cost for 5th year after warranty The price break up mentioned in the financial document should match with the prices qouted i n GeM online price bid. 7. Vendor Qualification Criteria:- 7.1 The average annual financial turnover of the bidder during last three years ending on 31.03.2026 shoul d be >/= Rs 99 Crores (or equivalenting foreign currency at exchange rate prevalent on that day) as per t he annual report (audited balance sheet and profit and loss account) of the relevant period duly authentica ted by chartered accountant in India or equivalent in relevant countries 7.2 The bidder/ OEM should have manufactured and supplied at least one such system of similar or higher specification in India/Abroad 7.3 The networth of the bidder and OEM should not be negative as on last date of submission of the bid an d should not have eroded by more than 30% in the last three years ending on 31.03.2026. 7.4 The bidder/ OEM should have adequate infrastructure required to perform the intended work 7.5 The bidder/ OEM should not have been debarred/ blacklisted by any Govt/ Abroad as on the date of sub mission of bid. Undertaking to its effect duly attested by Notary be enclosed with technical bid 7.6 The bidder is required to submit OEM Authorization certificate duly sealed , signed by authorized signa tory specifically issued for the subject tender. The OEM authorization should be valid till the delivery period + warranty. Product support after warranty for minimum period of 10 years should be agreed by OEM duly sealed and signed on letter head. The OEM has to ensure in writing that complete support will be provided for execution of the complete facility to bidder during currency of the contract period 7.7 Documentary proof for all the above VQC point should be submitted along with technical bid .
